title: marshmallow kid furniture
text: marshmallow kid furniture. Bought 2 of these for grandsons age 5 and 2.  They live in another State and they arrived today... Mom reports that the boys were THRILLED with them!  They squealed with delight when they discovered the seat folds down to create more of a lounge experience.  My daughter says the cover cover has a zipper to remove and wash (sold her right there) and they are the perfect solution to comfy seating in the kids tv/lounge loft.  I couldn't be happier.  They arrived quickly (I have prime) - one was "damaged and not delivered" but Amazon immediately sent a replacement.  I never hesitate to update my reviews if new info would be useful.  Further, I do NOT receive compensation of ANY kind for my reviews.

product_metadata.title: Marshmallow Furniture, Children's 2 in 1 Flip Open Foam Sofa, Disney/Pixar Disney Pixar Cars 2, by Spin Master
features: Soft Plush Children's Sized Sofa with Flip Open Lounger that's perfect for lounging, playing and sitting
Available in all your Favorite Preschool Characters
Removable & Machine Washable Slip Cover makes it easy to care for.
To un-zip the cover, slide a paper clip through the opening, pull upwards to unlock and slide to unzip
Note:The zipper does not have a pull for the children's safety.
description: Introducing the 2-in-1 Flip Open Sofa that’s the perfect size for young kids! Flip open the sofa and transform it into a lounger. Kid’s can snuggle up with their favorite preschool characters from Cars, Spiderman, Disney Princess, Sesame, Minnie Mouse, Dora and many more! These fun and functional foam sofas are incredibly durable and easy to clean. The removable and machine washable slipcover keeps the sofas in great condition making them 100% mom approved! Bring your child’s favorite characters to life as they sit, flip and play with Marshmallow’s Flip Open Sofas!
